faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Assistant (RA) post at Allahabad University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Assistant (RA) position at Allahabad University is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Assistant (RA) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree (B.E. /B.Tech) in Electronics and Communication Engineering or Electronics Engineering with a first division. A Master's degree is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years as of 1st April 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Assistant (RA) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You must download the application form, fill it, and send it along with supporting documents via Indian post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Junior Research Assistant (RA) under this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of this job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job, specifically for a research project at Allahabad University.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Allahabad University located?
faq.answer: Allahabad University is located in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 211002.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to submit a comprehensive CV and self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents, including mark sheets and certificates, along with the application form.
